requirements.requirement: The system must ingest clinical trial records from clinical_trials_service.py including phase, status, location, and eligibility fields.
The system must compute individual measure scores for at least three measures defined in the scoring schema.
The system must normalize each measure score according to the normalization rules defined in EVAL-CT-SCORE-SCHEMA-001.
The system must apply deterministic weights from the scoring schema to each normalized measure.
The system must compute a composite score as the weighted sum of all normalized measures.
The system must ensure the composite score is bounded within the range defined in the scoring schema (e.g., 0–100).
The system must produce identical composite scores for identical input trial data across repeated executions.
The system must return a breakdown of contributing measure scores alongside the composite score.
The system must handle missing measure inputs by applying default or fallback logic defined in the scoring schema.
The system must exclude trials from scoring if required minimum measures are not present and no fallback is defined.
The system must compute proximity score using available location data and a deterministic distance calculation method.
The system must map categorical fields (e.g., phase, status) to numeric scores using a predefined deterministic mapping.
The system must log scoring inputs and outputs for each trial to support traceability and debugging.
The system must gracefully return an empty result set when no valid clinical trials are available for scoring.
